critical_code_review_comments: ProductPage.jsx redirects unknown product slugs to '/' via <Navigate to='/' replace/>. User requirement said removed slugs should show a not-found state; consider rendering a lightweight 'Product not found' page or route (e.g. /product/*) with a link back rather than silently landing the user on the home page — this hurts SEO (200 on gone URLs) and is confusing UX.

seed.py DEFAULT_BLOG and DEFAULT_NEWS still reference 'Saizoner' and 'RMG' in editorial content (blog slug 'scaling-rmg-to-saizoner', news '500th Saizoner delivered'). Per the problem statement historical/editorial mentions in About/Global are intentional; but blog and news are current marketing content — worth confirming with product owner whether these should also be updated.

Backend has no dedicated per-id product update endpoint; PUT /api/admin/products is an upsert-by-slug that requires the full document. Admin UI works, but any client sending a partial payload will overwrite fields. Consider a PATCH endpoint.
action_items: Optional: replace silent redirect for unknown /product/:slug with an explicit 404 component to satisfy the 'not-found state' expectation and improve SEO.
Optional: refresh seed.py blog/news content ('Saizoner', 'RMG') if these should no longer appear in current marketing surfaces.
